rows.title_full: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE EARLY CHILDHOOD CARE AND DEVELOPMENT SYSTEM, AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Early Childhood Care And Development System Act
rows.abstract:
Provides for alignment of ECCD programs with existing programs on maternal and child health and nutrition. Mandates the ECCD Council to ensure alignment of the ECCD curriculum with the basic education curriculum and programs for learners with disability, based on an understanding of learning progression and inclusive learning design.
Reorganizes the ECCD Council, adding the Secretary of the Department of Interior and Local Government as ex-officio Vice Chairperson.
Delegates more responsibilities to LGUs in the implementation of ECCD programs through the Local Schools Boards to mobilize resources for the establishment, clustering and management of child development centers.
Creates an ECCD division in every city and municipality with their own design and implementation of its own organization structure and staffing pattern subject to the standards and guidelines prescribed by the Civil Service Commission.
Mandates that the ECCD programs shall be financed through a combination of public and private funds.
rows.status: Republic Act RA12199 enacted on 2025-05-08

rows.abstract:

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROHIBITING DISCRIMINATION ON THE BASIS OF SEXUAL ORIENTATION, GENDER IDENTITY OR EXPRESSION, OR SEX CHARACTERISTICS AND PROVIDING PENALTIES THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Sexual Orientation, Gender Identity Or Expression, Or Sex Characteristics Equality Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to protect individuals and communities that are at a greater risk of human rights violations based on sexual orientation, gender, identity or expression or sex characteristics (SOGIESC), including individuals and communities of diverse SOGIESC who are children, young, poor, persons with disabilities, indigenous peoples or persons of different ethnic background, or cultural background, and of various religious beliefs.
Itemizes different unlawful discriminatory practices on the basis of SOGIESC and provides penalty thereof.
Creates the SOGIESC Equality Congressional Oversight Committee (SECOC) composed of five (5) members each from the Senate and the House of Representatives.
Establishes the Inter-Agency Council on SOGIESC Equality which shall be composed of several government agencies and organizations.

rows.title_full: AN ACT ALLOWING FOR ELECTRONIC REGISTRATION AND VOTING OVERSEAS, FURTHER AMENDING REPUBLIC ACT NO. 9189, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'OVERSEAS ABSENTEE VOTING ACT OF 2003', AS AMENDED BY REPUBLIC ACT NO. 10590, OTHERWISE KNOWN AS THE 'OVERSEAS VOTING ACT OF 2013', AND APPROPRIATING FUNDS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Overseas Electronic Registration And Voting Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to expand the voting methods under existing laws and regulations to prevent voting disenfranchisement of OFWs and to further encourage them to exercise their right of suffrage.
Allows registration and/or certification as an overseas voter by mail or by electronic means as may be determined by the Commission on Elections.
Allows voting by mail or by electronic means in all posts abroad.
Prohibits any person to steal, conceal, alter, destroy, mutilate, manipulate, or in any way tamper with the mail or electronic data or information containing the ballots for overseas voters.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2024-05-15, transmitted to the Senate on 2024-05-20 and received by the Senate on 2024-05-20

rows.title_full: AN ACT PROTECTING SENIOR CITIZENS FROM VARIOUS FORMS OF FRAUD THROUGH INFORMATION DISSEMINATION AND PROVIDING MECHANISMS THEREFOR
rows.title_short: Senior Citizens Protection Against Fraud Act
rows.abstract:
Seeks to protect senior citizens from various forms of fraud using mail, telecommunications and other modern means of communication.
Mandates the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), through the local government units, to educate the senior citizens and their families and caregivers within their respective jurisdictions, general information on mail, telemarketing, and internet fraud targeting senior citizens and on how and where to report fraud.
Directs the Department of Information and Communications Technology (DICT) to provide the necessary technical assistance to the DILG, National Commission of Senior Citizens (NCSC) and the concerned government agencies on the development of a website and an online platform to facilitate coordination and sharing of information.
rows.status: Approved by the House on 2024-05-21, transmitted to the Senate on 2024-05-22 and received by the Senate on 2024-05-22

rows.author: I031;
rows.title_full: AN ACT INSTITUTING THE MAGNA CARTA OF FILIPINO MIGRANT WORKERS
rows.abstract:
Defines “Filipino Migrant Worker”:Â  a Filipino who is to be engaged, is engaged, or has been engaged in a remunerated activity in a country of which the said person is not an immigrant, citizen, or a permanent resident, or is not awaiting naturalization, recognition or admission, whether land-based or sea-based regardless of status; excluding a Filipino engaged under a government-recognized exchange visitor program for cultural and educational purposes.Â  For this Act, a person engaged in remunerated activity covers a person who has been contracted for overseas employment but has yet to leave the Phils., regardless of status, and includes “Overseas Contract Workers”.Â  This term is interchangeable with “Overseas Filipino Worker”.
Proposes for the amalgamation of the laws and decrees that intend to give more rights and privileges to migrant workers; Seeks to address certain loopholes and uncertainties for a stronger and more harmonious relationship between departments and agencies tasked with safeguarding the conditions of migrant workers.
Incorporates provisions that will pave the way for better working conditions and vigilant compliance with the rules and regulations that address the welfare of migrant workers and will prevent if not minimize the occurrence of certain violations and abuses committed against OFWs.
rows.status: Pending with the Committee on OVERSEAS WORKERS AFFAIRS since 2024-03-20
